title: Handoff QA
eyebrow: QA round 2 · session handoff in the desktop app, issue #406, plugin 2.77.0

short.lead: QA failed in the desktop app. Two desktop sessions ran this branch's hooks in separate fresh clones. The save and the pickup both worked, but the session that picked the work up could not restore it, because the plugin's own guards refuse the restore command the pickup prints. The fix needs a code change, and code edits are locked in the QA stage until you type "skip design". The cloud test and the second-account test have not started.
short.hint: Tap a row to see what was run and what it showed.
items: An uncommitted edit is saved to GitHub

Desktop session A, in the clone handoff-qa-A on the branch AjsAgent/session-handoff-qa, appended a line to docs/5-today/Today.md and committed nothing. git ls-remote then showed refs/house-rules/autosave/AjsAgent/session-handoff-qa at commit e724bf2. That commit held the new line and a facts file listing the branch and the two uncommitted files.
A new folder shows the saved work

Desktop session B, in a second fresh clone, opened with the block "house-rules pickup: loaded from refs/house-rules/remote-autosave/AjsAgent/session-handoff-qa". The block listed Today.md as existing only in the snapshot and printed a restore command. The saved Today.md matches session A's file exactly once Windows line endings are set aside.

Session B ran the printed command and the design-loop guard (the check that locks code edits by stage) refused it, because the command names the stage file .claude/house-rules-loop.json. When I ran the same command with only Today.md, the main guard (the general safety check on shell commands) refused it too, because it refuses every git restore. My earlier terminal test missed this because I ran the restore from my own shell, where those guards do not apply. The fix has two parts. First, the pickup leaves the stage file out of the restore command. Second, the main guard allows a restore from a handoff snapshot when none of the files named in the command has unsaved edits.
Type "skip design" in this chat so I can make the fix.
The installed copy still ran in the desktop app

Each test clone's .claude/settings.local.json turned off the installed plugin (2.76.0), and claude plugin list showed it as disabled there. In the desktop app, the copy it syncs from claude.ai (also 2.76.0) ran anyway: session B's end-of-reply feedback came from both the clone's plugin and the installed one. This did not change the handoff results, but a folder's settings cannot fully switch off the installed copy in the desktop app.
